title: Alibi and Witness
author: Felix Okafor
blurb: Felix Thackeray, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
